hidden_dependencies_found.finding: Magpie TTS ships NO audio codec. model_config.yaml inside the .nemo declares codecmodel_path: nvidia/nemo-nano-codec-22khz-1.89kbps-21.5fps. The checkpoint holds 16 codebook embedding tables and emits audio tokens; nothing in it turns tokens into a waveform.
hidden_dependencies_found.evidence: magpie_tts_multilingual_357m.nemo -> ./model_config.yaml, extracted by TAR member walk. Archived at artifacts/magpie_model_config.yaml.
hidden_dependencies_found.predicted_by: 01_STACK_DECISION.md section 2.2 row L5: 'If the codec ships as a separate checkpoint it is a separate row - verify at T011 before G0 closes.' It does.

hidden_dependencies_found.finding: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B carries LM + vision tower + MTP in ONE safetensors file (873,438,784 total). LM subtree 752,393,024 and MTP subtree 20,452,864 both confirm the prior EXACTLY. Vision tower 100,592,896.
hidden_dependencies_found.consequence: Excluding the vision tower is valid under B-2 ONLY because the shipped artefact is the LM-only GGUF. Any build shipping the upstream safetensors takes +100,592,896.
hidden_dependencies_found.action: Recorded in ledger.json as a NOT-COUNTED row with the build-time assertion made explicit.

hidden_dependencies_found.finding: pfluo/k2fsa-zipformer-chinese-english-mixed also contains exp/rnn-lm-small-text-19.pt = 11,400,010 params, an optional LM-rescoring model.
hidden_dependencies_found.consequence: Zero unless a build enables LM rescoring. Recorded so it cannot be enabled silently.

hidden_dependencies_found.finding: Supertone/supertonic-3 ships TEN voice styles (F1-F5, M1-M5), not five. Per style = 12,928 (style_ttl [1,50,256] + style_dp [1,8,16]).
hidden_dependencies_found.consequence: Row D6b is 129,280, not 64,640. The per-style figure in section 2.3 was right; the count of styles was not.
hidden_dependencies_found.note: Shipping five styles is a different, smaller ledger under L-2.

hidden_dependencies_found.finding: Silero v5_cis_base does NOT bundle an accentor. Its constructor takes accentor=None and no accentor tensors exist in the archive.
hidden_dependencies_found.consequence: REFUTES the premise behind section 2.2's 100,000,000 bound. L needs an EXTERNAL RU stress row. See A5 row L9.
